title: Lifewit 60L Clothes Storage Bags, Foldable Under-Bed Storage Bags,6 Pack
features: Multi-Pack Options: Each storage bag measures 55cm x 35cm x 31.5cm with 60L capacity. You have the option to choose between a 4-Pack, 6-Pack, and 8-Pack. With so much room, you can easily store winter clothes, sweaters, pillows, blankets and quilts. Keep your home neat and clean.
Premium Fabric:The storage bag is made of high quality, odorless, breathable, non-woven fabric that is soft and strong at the same time. With clear windows, you can easily identify stored items.

Wide Opening: With a tough two-way zipper that creates a wide opening, you can easily store and remove large items without messing up other items in the bag. The zipper prevents dust from entering and the bag is convenient for long-term use.

Reinforced Handle: Sewn with two layers of thick fabric, the bag has double load-bearing capacity. Reinforced seams are also implemented for added strength making it easy to move the storage bag in and out of the closet.
Multiple Use: These Clothes Storage Bags are conveniently designed to easily fold into drawers for saving space. These storage bags can be used in closets or shelves.
